column4: Why

column3: Every tool and button has a user_label (≤5 words) and a user_description (≤12 words) in Tab 17. The app renders ONLY these fields. Internal descriptions, rule text and notes are never rendered. A missing label falls back to 'Try {pathway}' and logs an error.
column4: Fixes the card that showed 'The user's own rituals, prayers, recitations, schedules and reminders' as a button.

column3: The 'Because…' text must mention something from every step the user completed: capacity (state name), feelings with strength, body or senses (if given), what context changed (if anything) and the band. Then the suggestion and what comes next.
column4: Users felt unheard when the reason only repeated their feelings.

column3: At most 3 short sentences and 60 words; plain words; no internal terms (no 'intervention', 'NUCRIPCE', 'band', cell IDs).

Routine → 'familiar, simple tasks'; Exploration → 'light exploring or learning'; Interest → 'something you enjoy'; Challenge → 'a stretching task'; Novelty → 'something new'; Urgency → 'the one thing that can't wait'; Passion → 'something that matters to you'; Collaboration → 'something with other people'. Always give one concrete example.
'You're in {state}: {meaning}. You said you feel {feelings}{ and {body/senses}}. {context sentence}. Right now {plain demand types} fit best, like {example}. {CTA question}'
column4: Context sentence examples: 'Being on a noisy bus without headphones makes this harder, so we've moved you from yellow to amber.' / 'Your headphones help, so you stay in yellow.'
